prompt.title: Setup prompt
prompt.description: Copy it into an agent tool such as Claude Code or Cursor, and it adds MoleSignal as an MCP server.
prompt.text_stdio:
Add MoleSignal as an MCP server and connect to it:
- Name: molesignal
- Transport: stdio
- Command: npx -y @molesignal/cli mcp
Before adding it, run npx -y @molesignal/cli login --url {{address}} in a terminal: it opens a browser to sign in to MoleSignal and approve access; no API key is needed.
If no browser can open, set MOLESIGNAL_URL={{address}} and MOLESIGNAL_TOKEN=<MoleSignal API token> in this MCP server's environment instead; I will create the token in MoleSignal and give it to you.
Once it is set up, list the tools molesignal offers to confirm the connection.
prompt.text_http:
Add MoleSignal as an MCP server and connect to it:
- Name: molesignal
- URL: {{endpoint}}
- Transport: Streamable HTTP
- Authentication: OAuth 2.1. Connecting opens a browser to sign in to MoleSignal and approve access; no API key is needed.
If you do not support OAuth, send the header Authorization: Bearer <MoleSignal API token> instead; I will create the token in MoleSignal and give it to you.
Once it is set up, list the tools molesignal offers to confirm the connection.
